summary: The current workspace, deterministic post-actor results, and Git diff agree: the runtime binding now targets the existing supportAssistant export, the obsolete source remains deleted, and dynamic tool registration is represented by an agent-owned unresolved warning without an invented binding.

requirements.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml binds support.runtimeAgent to /src/support-assistant.ts#supportAssistant, and src/support-assistant.ts exports supportAssistant. The Git diff replaces /src/support-agent.ts#supportAgent with that binding and shows src/support-agent.ts remains deleted. Workspace assertions show only moldea/moldea.yaml changed during the actor run, while deterministic-after passed validation and typechecking.

moldea/moldea.yaml records agents.support.unresolved.dynamic-tool-registration with effect warning, explains that static inspection cannot establish the dynamically assembled registrations, provides the concrete resolution of a repository-local integration test constructing the final support runtime and proving its registrations, and relates /src/dynamic-tools.ts. The diff adds this unresolved warning and adds no tool binding; deterministic-after reports valid inspection and no failures.
